updates.title: Owner role and Levies & Payments
items: New Owner home: levies due across all your units and a “Needs your attention” list
Every unit has its own unique payment reference (e.g. ACA-P012)
Managing agent uploads the bank statement (CSV) – payments with the right reference are allocated automatically
Wrong reference? The owner uploads proof of payment and the agent allocates it by hand
Owners get a confirmation and a receipt for every allocated payment
Professional statements with every levy and charge, ready to print or save as PDF
Debit order form, pre-filled, to print, sign and upload
My units, My tenants & rent (renewals, deposits) and Income & costs for tax
Fixes: correct due and overdue dates, tenants no longer see the owner’s levy account, demo data made consistent
